_note: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, standard tier, short context. Prices move. Re-check every rate against the vendor page on the morning of your run and update 'checked_on'. The report prints this date next to every cost figure.
caveats: Anthropic has published that Claude Sonnet 5 introductory pricing reverts to 3.00 / 15.00 on 1 September 2026. If your contract window crosses that date, model the reverted rate.
OpenAI bills 2x input and 1.5x output on requests above 272K input tokens. Support triage prompts are ~700 tokens, so the long-context meter does not apply here.
Gemini Pro tiers double input above 200K tokens. Flash and Flash-Lite tiers do not.
Batch tiers are roughly half price on all three vendors but are asynchronous. Support triage is synchronous, so batch pricing is out of scope for this comparison.
